evidence: Sets fogStart/fogEnd of the two StageLightPresets from the stage setting pair; a preset without fog takes the other one's fog end.
fogEnd = draw distance option (GetGraphicsOptionBits21To24 + 2) * 50 / weather factor g_unk0x0051b114[type]; fixed 15/80 on some stages.
Blends the primary and secondary StageLightPreset of the stage setting pair from the .hor records for the two times of day.
Interpolates the .hor light preset records of the two time columns around a time of day into one preset.
Interpolates two 0x4e-byte light presets: the seven fixed-point values, the eleven colours and the six colour correction bytes.
